## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the scoped issue and describe the observable change.

## Validation

Record exact commands/results and relevant positive, invalid, boundary and recovery checks. Link raw evidence for physical claims; builds and fixtures do not qualify boards.

## Review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and applicable tests are satisfied; limitations are explicit.
- [ ] Interfaces, generated outputs and documentation are synchronized where affected.
- [ ] No production keys, runtime data, build products or flash backups are included.
- [ ] Link hardware acceptance separately if it remains open. Avoid closing a physical-validation issue from a software-only PR.
